players.bio: Akinlolu Richard Olamide Famewo (born 9 November 1998) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers. Born in Lewisham, Greater London, Famewo joined Luton Town as an under-10 and progressed through the club's youth system.

Atsuki Itō is a Japanese footballer who plays as a defensive midfielder or a centre back for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers and the Japan national team. Club career On 13 August 2024, Ito signed a four-year contract with Gent in Belgium.

Benjamin Keith Davies (born 11 August 1995) is an English professional footballer who plays as a centre-back or left-back for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers. Davies spent most of his early career with Preston North End, and had loan spells with York City, Tranmere Rovers, Southport, Newport County and Fleetwood Town.

Christian Kai John Forino-Joseph (born 26 April 2000) is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Bolton Wanderers. He is a product of the Brentford Academy and played his first senior football with non-League clubs Wingate & Finchley and Loughborough University.
Cyrus Sylvester Frederick Christie (born 30 September 1992) is a professional footballer who plays as a right-back for V.League 1 club Hanoi FC.
David Harrington (born 1 July 2000) is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL League One club Bolton Wanderers.
David Shankland Watson (born 12 February 2005) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as an attacking midfielder for Scottish Premiership club Kilmarnock.
Eoin Toal (born 15 February 1999) is a Northern Irish professional footballer who plays for Bolton Wanderers, as a defender.
Ethan Erhahon (born 9 May 2001) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Bolton Wanderers.
Gaizka Larrazabal Goikoetxea is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a right wing-back or right winger for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers..

Gavin Okeroghene Bazunu is an Irish professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers and the Republic of Ireland national team. He started his career at Shamrock Rovers, making his first team debut in June 2018 at the age of 16, before joining Manchester City in February 2019.

Jack Elliott Bonham is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers. Bonham signed a scholarship deal with Watford in June 2010, but quickly signed his first professional contract three months later, having just turned 17. Although born in England, he represented Republic of Ireland at U17 level.

Jayden Nelson (born September 26, 2002) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a winger for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers and the Canada national team. Nelson began playing for Toronto FC Academy in the USSDA in 2016, playing for the U14 team. He has since played for the U16/17 and U18/19 teams as well.

John George McAtee (born 23 July 1999) is an English footballer who plays as a striker for EFL League One club Bolton Wanderers. He has previously played for Shrewsbury Town where he began his career, taking in loan spells with Halesowen Town, AFC Telford United, Ashton United and Curzon Ashton.
Joshua Luke Sheehan (born 30 March 1995) is a Wales professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for League One club Bolton Wanderers and the Wales national team.

Kyliane Dong is a 21-year-old French professional footballer who plays as a winger and forward for English Football League (EFL) Championship club Bolton Wanderers, on loan from Bundesliga side FC Augsburg. Born on 27 September 2004, he is known for his explosive pace and ability to play on either flank or as a central striker.

Lewis Brunt is an English professional footballer who plays as a defender for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers. Mainly a centre-back, he can also play as a left-back or defensive midfielder. Club career Aston Villa Brunt started his career at Aston Villa. After playing for the Under-18s and Under-23s, he was given his first professional contract by Villa in November 2018.
Luca Stephenson is an English professional footballer who plays as a right-back or defensive midfielder for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers.
Maxwell "Max" John Conway (born 5 September 2003) is an English footballer who plays as a defender for EFL League One club Bolton Wanderers.
Nathan Lee Broome (born 3 January 2002) is an English professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Bolton Wanderers.

Rúben da Rocha Rodrigues is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a midfielder or a forward for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers. He played in the Netherlands since the junior levels and started his career in the lower divisions.

Ryan Hardie (born 17 March 1997) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a forward for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers, on loan from fellow EFL Championship club Wrexham. Hardie started his career with Rangers, and was loaned by them to Raith Rovers, St Mirren and Livingston. He moved to English club Blackpool in July 2019.
Samuel George Dalby (born 7 December 1999) is an English professional footballer who plays for Bolton Wanderers.

Samuel Iling-Junior is an English professional footballer who plays as a winger or wing-back for EFL Championship club Bolton Wanderers, on loan from Premier League club Aston Villa. A youth product of Chelsea and Juventus, Iling-Junior made his debut for reserve team Juventus U23 in the 2021–22 season, while also reaching the UEFA Youth League semi-finals with the U19 squad.

Stephen Daniel Crainey (born 22 June 1981) is a Scottish former professional footballer. He is currently assistant manager for Bolton Wanderers. A left back, he made 319 appearances in the Premier League and Football League, including 214 for Blackpool.
Steven Thomas Schumacher (born 30 April 1984) is an English football manager and former professional footballer, who is currently head coach of EFL League One club Bolton Wanderers.

Thelonius Alston Bradley "Theo" Bair (born August 27, 1999) is a Canadian professional soccer player who plays as a forward for Bolton Wanderers, on loan from Ligue 1 club AJ Auxerre, and the Canada national team.
Thierry Gale (born 1 May 2002) is a Barbadian professional footballer who plays as a forward for Bolton Wanderers and the Barbados national team. Currently sponsored By Sign-Tech
Xavier Levi Simons (born 20 February 2003) is an English professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for EFL League One club Bolton Wanderers.
